Artwork

L-panel artwork supplied as…
Supply the whole wall face at 117 x 93" (1.258:1). The top-left 102 x 15" is taken as panel C and the right-hand 15 x 93" as panel D — the middle is ignored, so a file with the window knocked out works fine.
Print sizes are now straight off Freeman's spec sheet — A 117 x 93" fabric, C 102 x 15" Ultraboard, D 15 x 93.3125" Ultraboard, G 38.125 x 35.75" PVC. Freeman's design note: A spans the full wall, and C and D are designed to overlap — keep critical elements out of the top-right corner where they meet.

Supply the L either way: as separate C and D files, or as one 117 x 93" wall file that gets sliced into both. Switching modes does not resample anything.

Counter is modelled at the listing's exact 39" x 19.5" x 41" cabinet size, plus a 1" worktop lip and a recessed toe kick. Backwall is 8' H — stated on the ALTA ONE listing and corroborated by Freeman's NACDS turnkey sheet. L-panel is 1'-6" on both legs, leaving a 102" x 78" open window.

Artwork is final-fit. Backdrop and L-panel files match the modelled sizes exactly — no scaling or cropping applied. The L-panel cutout measures 18.03" on both legs and its window is 101.97" x 77.97".
